title: thread.md
description: Parsed frontmatter of an LHR thread.md (file-format-v2).

anchor.path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the file the thread is on

anchor.blob.description: Git object ID of the content the line numbers refer to; required for line threads

anchor.startLine.description: First anchored line, 1-based (>= 1); required for line threads

anchor.endLine.description: Last anchored line, inclusive (>= startLine); required for line threads

anchor.contextBefore.description: Snapshot lines before startLine (>= 0); required for line threads

anchor.contextAfter.description: Snapshot lines after endLine (>= 0); required for line threads
